notes: Ground truth for live planner accuracy. reference_sql is hand-written against the Chinook DuckDB file and is the authority; the planner never sees it. Questions are chosen to have a single deterministic answer (scalars, tie-free top-N, or distinct grouping keys).

cases.question: What is the total revenue across all invoices?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice

cases.question: How many invoices are there in total?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice

cases.question: How many customers do we have?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer

cases.question: What is the average invoice total?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice

cases.question: What is the largest single invoice total?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT MAX(Total) FROM Invoice

cases.question: What is the smallest invoice total?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT MIN(Total) FROM Invoice

cases.question: How many distinct billing countries appear on invoices?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BillingCountry) FROM Invoice

cases.question: How many customers are located in the USA?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'USA'

cases.question: How many customers are in Brazil?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

cases.question: What is the total revenue from invoices billed to the USA?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'USA'

cases.question: How many invoices have a total greater than 10?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE Total > 10

cases.question: How many invoices were billed to either Canada or France?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry IN ('Canada', 'France')

cases.question: What are the top 5 customer countries by total invoice revenue?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.Country, SUM(i.Total) FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Country ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: Which 2 billing countries have the most invoices?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, COUNT(*) FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 2

cases.question: Show total invoice revenue for every billing country, highest first, limited to 24 rows.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 24

cases.question: How many invoices were there each year?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', InvoiceDate), COUNT(*) FROM Invoice GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
cases.note: the compiler buckets with DATE_TRUNC, so the period is a timestamp rather than an integer year; both express the same grouping

cases.question: List the customers based in Brazil.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT CustomerId, FirstName, LastName, Company, City, State, Country, SupportRepId FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'
cases.note: projection is every non-PII Customer column, so Address/Phone/Fax/Email/PostalCode are absent by construction

cases.question: How many tracks have we sold in total?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM InvoiceLine
cases.note: Quantity is always 1 in Chinook, so COUNT(*) and SUM(Quantity) agree

cases.question: How many employees work for us?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee

cases.question: Which music genre has sold the most tracks? Just the top one.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which artist has the most albums? Just the top one.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.Name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many customers does each support rep have? Identify the rep by their id.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SupportRepId, COUNT(*) FROM Customer GROUP BY SupportRepId
cases.note: the question pins the grouping key to the id; without that, grouping by the rep's name is equally defensible and there is no ground truth

cases.question: How many tracks are there of each media type? Show the media type name, not its id.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT mt.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name
cases.note: pinned to the name so the case tests whether the planner joins out to the label table rather than returning opaque ids

cases.question: What is the average revenue per customer?
cases.reason: needs SUM(Total)/COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId); the IR cannot express a ratio, so the planner must decline rather than average per invoice

cases.question: What was the percentage growth in revenue from 2023 to 2024?
cases.reason: needs a period-over-period ratio, not expressible in the IR

cases.question: How much did we spend with our suppliers last quarter?
cases.reason: no supplier or purchasing tables exist in the catalog

cases.question: How many people visited our website in March?
cases.reason: no web analytics data exists in the catalog

cases.question: List every customer's email address.
cases.reason: Email is pii_risk=high and must never be returned

cases.question: What is the email address of the customer whose last name is Gonçalves?
cases.reason: Email is pii_risk=high and must never be returned

cases.question: Group customers by their email address and count them.
cases.reason: grouping by Email would emit PII values as group keys

cases.question: What is the phone number of the employee whose last name is Adams?
